text_block_list.text:
With her battle against Eishin Flash at 
the Arima Kinen looming— Gold Ship 
suddenly, like, really suddenly, awakens 
to the concept of beauty!

Gold Ship aims to conquer the world with 
beauty. Unable to let that slide, an 
incarnation of beauty(?) arrives on the 
scene—TM Opera O!

A clash radiating an aura of beauty so 
intense it threatens to upset your 
stomach... The very definition of beauty 
is pushed to its limits. Neither one gives 
an inch—

—Having acknowledged each other as 
formidable rivals, Gold Ship and TM Opera 
O. Nothing is more beautiful than this 
friendship... It's a draw!
